note: Nothing in this file is a live default. A preset becomes live only through an activation record (date, preset hash, policy version, owner sign-off, release commit, evidence path) written at release. The decision block records what the owner chose on 27 September 2026; existing funded campaigns keep their sealed terms.

devSupply.appliesTo: new Standard campaigns on the version-3 issuer; existing coins keep their sealed 3 percent

funding.minimumCommitmentEnforcedBy: API commit preparation (the version-3 layout has no field for it)

operating.decision: owner, 27 September 2026: option 1, a creator-funded reserve, then self-funding from the coin's own treasury fee share; numbers set under 'do the rest' and adjustable before activation
operating.payer: the keeper signer of the release manifest (signerPublicKey); the rehearsal uses its local treasury key
operating.coverage: keeper transactions after creation: settlement, launch, refunds and fee cycles. The pool-initialization reserve inside the setup quote is separate and returns to the creator through the program.
operating.fundedBy: a separate creator approval after registration: a transfer to the payer carrying a memo that binds it to the campaign, credited to the campaign's operating budget on finalized chain evidence

liquidity.lpLock: permanent (Raydium lock, fee NFT to the program)

capPresets.label: Private pilot (1 to 5 SOL)
capPresets.decision: owner, 27 September 2026, 22:35 UTC: a pilot-only preset, usable only behind the pilot wallet restriction and removed before the public opening

schedule.startRule: creator picks a future UTC start or opens on confirmation; the program enforces the start
schedule.note: PILOT SETTING (owner, 28 September 2026): ten-minute funding round and a twenty-minute launch window so test launches are quick; restore 7200 / 7200 before the public opening. The launch window needs the worst-case settlement benchmark (Shartcoin: 196 receipts settled and refunded in 3 m 30 s)

unresolved.note: explicit policy for the new Family version only; existing campaigns never expire
committing wallet pays its own receipt rent; any execution budget quoted, never deducted

decision.summary: Standard split 47.5 / 47.5 / 5 with dev 1.5 percent at launch and 3.5 percent linear over three calendar months; presets 50 to 100 SOL and 100 to 250 SOL; two-hour funding window; two-hour launch window; minimum commitment 0.05 SOL; no per-wallet cap; operating funding option 1 (creator reserve, then self-funding from the coin fee share). Sealed in the program as split policy 3 and vesting rule 2. Activation still requires the release record below.
